summary: v637 plus a bounded Q/K bet: force only the QKS smoothing acceptance. q <- q*s, k <- k/s is exactly logits-preserving ((q*s).(k/s) = q.k), so it cannot corrupt the logits - it only redistributes quantization difficulty. Official sample 0.154586 -> 0.247073 and online_profiled_v2 0.610325 -> 0.631833, both up, with the gq and refinement guards left honest.
patches:
QKS_STABILITY = True        # False = skip the stability filter (diagnostics)
# v639: force ONLY the Q/K smoothing fit to be accepted. This is the one Q/K lever that is
# EXACTLY logits-preserving: q <- q*s and k <- k/s give (q*s).(k/s) = q.k elementwise, so it
# cannot move the logits at all - it only redistributes quantization difficulty between the
# two roles. The gq (GPTQ) and refinement guards are left honest, because forcing gq alone
# measured -1139 on the official sample while this measures +2312.
QKS_STABILITY = False
QKS_GUARD = True            # False = accept any finite fit (diagnostics)
QKS_GUARD = False
